title: Solar-Powered Clean Water Pump
description: Deploying durable solar-powered water filtration pumps to rural communities lacking clean drinking water access.
reward_info: Access to project updates & name engraved on the community thank-you plaque.

title: Neptune: Modular Mechanical Keyboard
description: An ergonomic, hot-swappable modular keyboard designed for programmers, writers, and power-users.
reward_info: Early Bird Neptune Keyboard kit with keycap set of choice.

title: Whispers of the Wind: Art Exhibition
description: An interactive digital art exhibition showcasing environmental changes through kinetic wind sculptures.
reward_info: Limited-edition high-quality signed print of the main installation.

title: Urban Farm: Hydroponic Towers
description: Building community-led vertical hydroponic towers to bring fresh, pesticide-free produce to city centers.
reward_info: A basket of fresh community harvest monthly for 3 months.

title: Portable Braille E-Reader
description: An affordable, compact digital Braille reader that converts PDFs and web text into tactile characters.
reward_info: Beta testing unit and lifetime software updates.

title: Mobile Health Clinic for Remote Areas
description: Renovating a utility truck to provide basic pediatric checks and healthcare services to outlying regions.
reward_info: Personalized video update from a field clinic trip and progress newsletter.

title: Zero-Waste Cafe Startup
description: Opening a local cafe focusing on 100% compostable packaging, organic ingredients, and zero single-use plastic.
reward_info: Custom reusable glass coffee mug and 5 free coffee vouchers.

title: Coding Camp for Underprivileged Youth
description: A 6-week intensive bootcamp covering web development fundamentals, hosting, and professional resume building.
reward_info: Invite to the student final project showcase and demo day.
